title: The Netherlands built new islands from 37 million tonnes of lake sediment
summary_full: In an innovative move, Dutch engineers have fashioned new islands from lake sediment to rejuvenate a fragile freshwater ecosystem. These manmade structures have swiftly drawn an array of flora and fauna, notably various bird populations. The initiative has revitalised an ailing lake, transforming it into a bustling habitat for marine life and migratory birds alike.
